title: Verdant cell
description: Faceted cyanobacterial cell with chlorophyll-inspired pigment blocks; no invented eyes or limbs.

title: Ochre forager
description: Generic bacterivore marker; its single stylized appendage is an art convention, not an asserted species diagnosis.

title: Twin-thread Bodo
description: Kidney-like faceted cell with unequal anterior and trailing flagella; red is the existing research species color, not natural pigmentation.

title: Tideback prowler
description: Low amphibious quadruped: broad skull, offset armored back, splayed limbs and a tapered swimming tail.

title: Reedrunner scout
description: Light biped: cream throat, small narrow head, deep hip, folded forelimbs and counterbalancing tail.

title: Crestgrazer browser
description: Stocky browser: deep abdomen, layered brow shield, broad beak and weight-bearing limbs. Original silhouette, not an extracted game model.
